page.overview:
Who is Kallik?

Kallik lost her entire family during the Hundred Year War. Sometime after the war, seeking a place to belong, she joined Jie and the Denied, a nonbending extremist group that sought to overturn the existing order through violence.

Around 110 AG, Kallik participated in a mission led by Jie, leader of the Denied, to seize the statuette of Sonam from the Southern Air Temple. They ambushed Avatar Aang during his journey to the temple. Despite Aang showing no intent to fight, they continued attacking him so that Hong, one of their comrades, could search through the Avatar's collection. When Hong called out that he had found the statuette, the airbender quickly reclaimed it and ascended to the top of the tower. In pursuit, Kallik followed him to the beams with her rope dart and confronted him there.

During their struggle, an explosive arrow shot by Jie nearly struck Kallik until she was saved by Aang, however, who dropped the statuette to catch her, losing consciousness briefly upon hitting the ground. The ensuing explosion destabilized the tower. Realizing it was about to collapse, Jie and the others fled, shouting for Kallik to grab the scroll that had slipped from the statuette. Though confused that the Avatar had saved her, she obeyed and escaped. As they rushed back to their airship waiting outside, the upper half of the structure began to tilt, threatening to crush the airship. Yet Aang awakened and entered the Avatar State, earthbending it back into place, letting Kallik and her group get away.

Upon discovering the map, Kallik traveled with the Denied across the Endless Ocean to snatch Sonam's staff. During the voyage, she spotted the Avatar and the Fire Lord's airship through a telescope. A brief clash broke out, and just as Tagah was about to crash the Denied's airship, Aang intervened by airbending away all their grappling hooks and unleashing a powerful gust of wind to push the two parties apart. They entered the Immortal Storm, where they lost sight of Team Avatar. As they struggled through the storm for hours, Tagah emerged from the mist, declared the Avatar dead, and promised them a new world where they would have the power. In exchange for their loyalty, he granted airbending to every member of the Denied, including Kallik.
